moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot as two royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin caps step in behind Juliana and seize her arms.

moments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
moments.text: Let me go!

moments.speaker: CAMERA

moments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
moments.text: Please! Someone!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on the Noble Matriarch freezing in utter shock and outrage.

moments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
moments.text: Take your hands off her.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.

moments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
moments.text: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind h

moments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
moments.text: Stand aside, stranger!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium close-up profile on The Bearded Stranger, eyes burning with quiet, lethal resolve.

moments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
moments.text: I said...

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's intense, scarred face.

moments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
moments.text: ...let her go.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.

moments.speaker: ACTION
moments.text: The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed

moments.speaker: SOUND FX
moments.text: A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium close-up of Gerald turning frantically to the remaining guards and congregation, panicking.

moments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
moments.text: What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.

moments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
moments.text: Are you hurt?

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes her head gently, overwhelmed with wonder.

moments.speaker: ACTION
moments.text: Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up profile of The Bearded Stranger casting a sharp, menacing glance toward the other guard.

moments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
moments.text: Good. Then don't touch her again.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch shrieking in exasperation from the altar steps.

moments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
moments.text: You cannot interfere in a family matter!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up of Juliana's elderly father looking down, gripping his hands nervously with profound guilt.

moments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.)
moments.text: I can...

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot of guests in the pews whispering and reacting in hushed shock.

moments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.)
moments.text: ...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger and Lady Juliana framed against the illuminated stained-glass rose window.

moments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
moments.text: You shouldn't have to beg anybody...

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on Juliana looking up into his eyes, moved to the core.

moments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.)
moments.text: ...to remember your worth.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's rugged, bearded face looking down at her with tender reverence.

moments.text: Please... enough!

moments.text: Ah!

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: Stop!

moments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
moments.text: They have been—

moments.speaker: ACTION

moments.text: You see?

moments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN

moments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
moments.text: I am not delusional!

moments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN

moments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
moments.text: You are merely confused.

moments.speaker: CAMERA

moments.speaker: CATHERINE
moments.text: How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists...

moments.speaker: CATHERINE
moments.text: ...is the maid who claims to have discovered it.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.

moments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
moments.text: Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.

moments.speaker: ACTION
moments.text: Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

moments.speaker: JULIANA
moments.text: No!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

moments.speaker: CATHERINE
moments.text: Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.

moments.speaker: JULIANA
moments.text: Give it back!

moments.speaker: JULIANA
moments.text: It belonged to my mother!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Low-angle shot tracking the silver locket as Catherine casually flings it across the stone corridor floor.

moments.speaker: CATHERINE (O.S.)
moments.text: A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows.

moments.speaker: SOUND FX
moments.text: Metallic clatter as the silver pendant bounces against the wooden baseboard.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot of Juliana being dragged further into the doorway, staring helplessly toward her discarded locket.

moments.speaker: JULIANA
moments.text: My mother's locket!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.

moments.speaker: ACTION
moments.text: Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.

moments.speaker: CATHERINE
moments.text: Juliana...

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Extreme close-up on the handwritten inscription: 'Juliana Ashcroft'.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.

moments.speaker: ACTION
moments.text: Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.

moments.speaker: CATHERINE
moments.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium two-shot as Catherine steps deliberately up to Juliana, circling her like a predator savoring its prey.

moments.speaker: CATHERINE
moments.text: I knew I had seen those eyes before.

moments.speaker: CATHERINE
moments.text: The disgraced daughter...

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
moments.text: A traitor?

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: Yes.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: We were close to finding him.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: Then came the ambush.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: My men were slaughtered.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
moments.text: And you?

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: I was shot. Left for dead.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
moments.text: How did you escape?

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
moments.text: Then why did they never tell us?

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
moments.text: Who?

moments.text: No...

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: Then where is she?

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
moments.text: They arrested her!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: Arrested?

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
moments.text: Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: But she saved you!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
moments.text: I told them!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: You told them the truth!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
moments.text: They called her a witch!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: Juliana... is in a cell?

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
moments.text: She was taken before a magistrate.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER
moments.text: And?!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

moments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
moments.text: They condemned her.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.

moments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
moments.text: No...

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her sorrow turning into burning outrage.

moments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
moments.text: You knew this before I walked through those doors!

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Medium shot of Gerald standing stoic and impassive next to the smug Lady in Gold Gown.

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.

moments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
moments.text: You let me come here...

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes with grief.

moments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
moments.text: You let me dress in my mother's gown...

moments.speaker: LADY JULIANA

moments.speaker: JULIANA

moments.speaker: CAMERA

moments.speaker: JULIANA

moments.speaker: CAMERA
moments.text: Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.

moments.speaker: CATHERINE
moments.text: Your soldier?
